title: OpenPlanning Meeting Schema v1
description: Defines a Meeting of a deciding body (e.g. Planning Commission, Town Council) with its ordered AgendaItems. Identity: optional `id` (uuid) is canonical. Otherwise the natural key for a Meeting is (jurisdiction, date) ,  unique_together at the model layer. AgendaItems are children of a Meeting and keyed on (meeting, order). Staff reports and resolutions are loaded by their own specs (staff_report/v1, resolution specs) ,  this spec only carries the meeting frame and its agenda.

source.description: Provenance of this data (e.g. agenda PDF or minutes packet).

municipality.description: Municipality these meetings belong to. Used to scope jurisdiction, application, and document lookups.

meeting_ref.description: Reference to another Meeting within the same municipality. Used by `minutes_approved_from` so a meeting can record which prior meeting's minutes it approved. Resolved by id when present, otherwise by natural key (jurisdiction_abbreviation, date). The referenced meeting is created as a stub if it does not yet exist, mirroring the legacy plan_loader behavior.

application_ref.description: Reference to an Application within the municipality. Resolved within the named jurisdiction by application_number, then file_number, then title.

document_ref.description: Reference to a documents.Document within the municipality. Resolved by source_url first, then by name.

id.description: Stable UUID primary key. When set, this is the canonical identifier across environments.

jurisdiction_abbreviation.description: Reviewing/deciding jurisdiction, resolved within the municipality (e.g. 'PC', 'TC', 'BZA').

date.description: Meeting date. (jurisdiction, date) is unique ,  there cannot be two meetings of the same body on the same day.

time.description: Meeting start time in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS (24-hour). Optional; many records do not capture it.

location.description: Free-form location string (e.g. 'Town House, 7547 Main Street').

minutes_approved_from.description: Prior meeting whose minutes this meeting approves. Self-referential link, typically within the same jurisdiction.

agenda_items.description: Ordered list of agenda items for this meeting. Children ,  natural key is (meeting, order).

order.description: Sequence number within the meeting. Together with the parent meeting this is the natural key.

title.description: Agenda line as printed (e.g. 'P-23-0026 / 7306 Springfield Avenue / Site Plan').

section.description: Which section of the agenda this item belongs to.

application.description: Optional Application this agenda item is reviewing. Resolved within the named jurisdiction.

documents.description: Documents to attach via the AgendaItem.documents M2M (agenda PDF, staff report, exhibits, etc.). Each is resolved by source_url first, then name.
